name: Wilcox Campground
note: Parks Canada campground in Jasper NP on the Icefields Parkway 3 km south of the Columbia Icefield; 46 primitive first-come sites, best suited to RVs under 27 ft; open June 10-Sep 28 (2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Parks Canada Jasper camping page (read 2026-10-19): Wilcox, 46 primitive sites, 'All sites available on a First Come, First Served basis', 'Best suited for motorhomes and trailers under 8.2 metres (27 feet)', June 10 to September 28
wf: satellite (Esri, sat.py) at 52.2192,-117.1758 read 2026-10-19: wooded loops on a slope above the parkway; no water; not waterfront

name: Wabasso Campground
note: Parks Canada campground in Jasper NP on Highway 93A 16 km south of Jasper, about 230 sites (50 electric). Closed to the public for 2026 after the 2024 wildfire while Parks Canada plans its rebuild; contractors only, no public reopening date (read 2026-10-19). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Parks Canada Jasper camping page (read 2026-10-19): 'Wabasso Campground ... will remain closed for the 2026 camping season'; Parks Canada interim-housing page lists 50 electrical and 79 unserviced sites opened to rebuild contractors June-Oct 2026; a long-standing drive-in RV campground (OSM capacity 235)
wf: satellite (Esri, sat.py) at 52.7655,-117.9880 (600 m half-width) read 2026-10-19: loops on a bench south of the Athabasca River; a continuous band of forest separates the nearest loop from the river; not waterfront

status.note: closed to the public for 2026 after the 2024 Jasper wildfire (contractor use only); no reopening date

name: Crandell Mountain Campground
note: Parks Canada campground in Waterton Lakes NP on the Red Rock Parkway, about 129 sites; closed since the 2017 Kenow wildfire. Stage one of the rebuild (utilities, water treatment) finished in 2021; stage two is unscheduled and no reopening date is set (read 2026-10-19). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Parks Canada Waterton camping page (read 2026-10-19): 'Crandell Mountain Campground: Campground closed. See the Infrastructure projects page'; infrastructure page: stage one completed 2021, stage two plans 'still being determined'; RV Life lists 129 sites
wf: satellite (Esri, sat.py) at 49.0999,-113.9576 (450 m half-width) read 2026-10-19: rebuilt loops on open ground south of Blakiston Creek; the nearest loop sits ~60 m back behind a brushy strip; not waterfront

status.note: closed since the 2017 Kenow wildfire; rebuild stage two unscheduled, no reopening date

name: William A. Switzer Provincial Park - Halfway Campground
note: Small Alberta Parks campground off Hwy 40 north of Hinton; 4 unserviced first-come sites, 'open sites suitable for RVs and tents', $30 a night, May 14-Sep 8; bring water. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Alberta Parks Halfway page (read 2026-10-19): 4 unserviced sites, 'open sites suitable for RVs and tents', First-Come First-Served, $30, May 14-Sep 8
wf: satellite (Esri, sat.py) at 53.4978,-117.7992 read 2026-10-19: a small open clearing beside the gravel access road; Jarvis Creek meanders ~100 m west through forest; not waterfront

name: Exshaw Community Campground
note: Community-association campground at Exshaw in the Bow Valley, 25 km east of Canmore; 16 sites (8 unserviced C$25, 15/30 A powered C$40), RVs to 24 ft per the intro (35 ft in the site details), first-come unless booked for a private event; no dump station. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: exshaw.ca campground page and rate sheet (read 2026-10-19): Exshaw Community Association, 16 sites, 'Sites 1-8 - $25.00/night, Sites 9-14, 16 - $40.00/night', first-come-first-served outside private rentals, RV sites to 24 ft (35 ft in site details); Google 3.8 over 27 reviews
